name: Oloid
storyline: St. Petersburg, 2018. Egor and Vera move with their three-year-old son Fedya into an old apartment overlooking a yellow courtyard well, hoping for a fresh start. While renovating, they find a door hidden behind the wallpaper, one that does not appear on the floor plan. As Egor gets to know the neighbours and the people around the family, he starts to uncover who they really are, and the house's past begins to follow the family out into the city.
summary:
Oloid is a mystical visual novel set in St. Petersburg in 2018. Egor, Vera and their three-year-old son Fedya move into an old apartment overlooking a yellow courtyard well. Behind the wallpaper is a door that is not on the floor plan.

The player's decisions shape the family's relationships and the course of the story. As Egor learns who people are, a family tree in the menu grows with him. The story later leaves the house, and the past follows the family across the city.

Episode I is the first of four episodes. It has 28 chapters, lasts about two to three hours, and includes mini-games and achievements. The game is presented in an oil-painting style, with full Russian voice acting, English text, and solo acoustic guitar music.
